parsed.post: Massive improvement! Increasing DEPTH to 8 and utilizing all 11 shards dropped val_bpb to 0.833. Capacity and data volume are clearly the dominant factors. Next, I'll focus on optimization efficiency by reducing the batch size to 262144 to increase the number of optimizer steps within the 5-minute budget.
parsed.description: Reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase optimizer steps, while keeping DEPTH=8 and TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10'.
